podcast.title: "Strange Fruit" and Political Activism
podcast.body: "Strange Fruit," a song about lynching, became Billy Holiday's most famous and politically charged performance. Its controversial nature led to its rejection by her main label, Columbia, but its eventual release by Milt Gabler on Commodore Records made it a historic success and a symbol of protest, evidenced by Rebecca Ferguson's attempt to perform it at Donald Trump's inauguration. "The song, which became Billy Holiday's best known performance, was Strange Fruit, and it was about lynching."
